overview.description: The Kurv SpaceX Enhanced Income ETF (XSHP) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in communication services equity. The fund is actively managed, seeking to maximize total returns through exposure to the Space Exploration Technologies Corp. (ticker: NASDAQ SPCX) XSHP was launched on Jun 17, 2026 and is issued by Kurv.
